payload.core_composition_summary: Binary search on answer with greedy feasibility check. Sort boys descending and bikes ascending; match richest to cheapest, use shared budget for deficits.
payload.rationale: Solution uses binary search to optimize number of boys, with a greedy matching strategy inside the check. Two distinct mechanisms: binary search framework and greedy exchange argument for assignment.
